items.explains: An instantaneous framing step gives an existing recorded moment a distinct accent.
items.action: Place a held key one frame before the cue and a larger-scale camera key on it, then hold or return.
useWhen: A deliberate hard framing accent supports a supplied spoken point.
avoidWhen: A smooth approach is required.
The cue has no preceding frame or repeated jumps would distract.
requirements: punchStep is a camera-track helper, not a direct scene family or a source edit.
atFrame must be >= 1 and the target scale must exceed the starting scale.
Use the normal 1.03-1.07 range, preserve head and screen clearance, and retain source speed.
A framing jump is not proof, a before/after result or an explanatory mechanism.

display.explains: يأكد اللحظة بتكبير مفاجئ بسيط.
display.useWhen: مع تأكيد يستحمل قطعة في الكادر.
display.avoidWhen: لو المطلوب حركة ناعمة أو الكادر ضيق.

items.explains: Gradual framing emphasis on an existing recorded subject, without explaining a new relationship.
items.action: Author camera-track keys that ease from the existing scale to a slightly closer view, then hold or release.
useWhen: A reflective spoken point benefits from sustained visual attention.
The source has a verified safe face or screen crop.
avoidWhen: A diagram or evidence comparison must explain the claim.
The push would cross a cut or hide source details.
requirements: This is a track-authoring helper, not a selectable scene family; convert its keys into the normal camera track.
slowPush requires toFrame > fromFrame; emphasisPunch needs earlier push frames and holdFrames > releaseFrames.
Normal punches are 1.03-1.07; the 1.10 hard ceiling requires the explicit allowHard helper option.
Use reviewed source cues for speech emphasis and inspect actual head/screen framing while preserving source speed.

display.explains: يقرب الكادر بهدوء على نفس الموضوع.
display.avoidWhen: لما المعنى محتاج رسم أو دليل.

items.explains: A short scale ramp accents a moment already present in the recording.
items.action: End a small camera scale increase on the chosen cue; snapIn uses a four-frame ramp by default.
useWhen: A concise recorded term or demonstrated detail needs one crisp accent.
avoidWhen: The passage needs quiet sustained reading.
The ramp would crop the face or meaningful UI.
requirements: snap-in authors camera-track keys; it is not a scene family.
snapIn requires integer rampFrames >= 2, enough frames before atFrame, and target scale above the starting scale.
Keep normal punches within 1.03-1.07 and verify the anchor against source framing.
The ramp does not alter speech speed or supply missing explanatory content.

display.explains: يقرب الكادر بسرعة خفيفة عند نقطة مهمة.
display.useWhen: مع كلمة أو تفصيلة تستاهل تأكيد.
display.avoidWhen: لو الكادر ضيق أو الشرح هادي جدًا.

items.explains: Colour identifies one word in the existing literal caption stream.
items.action: Apply readable theme accent ink to the caption word selected by sourceIndex without changing its text or cue.
useWhen: One reviewed recorded keyword should stand out in a stable caption.
avoidWhen: The intended words were never recorded.
A highlighted subtitle would replace an explanation the viewer needs.
requirements: Use captions.emphasis with an in-range recorded sourceIndex; entries must increase strictly and allow one kind per word.
Preserve reviewed caption words, timing and reviewer attribution; do not manufacture words in graphics mode.
The renderer shifts accent ink for contrast against the caption surface.

display.explains: يلون كلمة من الكابشن المراجع.
display.avoidWhen: لو الكلمة مش موجودة في التسجيل.

items.explains: A brief scale pulse accents one existing recorded caption word.
items.action: Start that word at scale 1.12 and settle to 1 over four frames using readable accent ink.
useWhen: An energetic recorded keyword warrants a brief pulse and has room around it.
avoidWhen: The style keeps caption pills static, including split-canvas and section-deck.
The point needs low-motion reading or the word is not recorded.
requirements: Use one valid reviewed sourceIndex per caption emphasis entry in strictly increasing order.
captionEmphasisIssues rejects pop for every style with defaults.staticCaptions; consult current style metadata.
The pulse changes an existing recorded word only and does not add dialogue or a source-free transcript.

display.explains: يدي كلمة الكابشن نبضة سريعة.
display.useWhen: مع كلمة قوية وستايل يسمح بالحركة.
display.avoidWhen: مع captions ثابتة أو كلمة متخيلة.

items.explains: An underline marks a recorded caption word without moving the line.
items.action: Draw a theme-coloured underline under the selected sourceIndex while retaining normal word colour.
useWhen: A recorded qualification or condition needs calm typographic emphasis.
avoidWhen: Unrecorded labels are being passed off as subtitles.
Underlining adjacent words would obscure the caption.
requirements: Select one in-range reviewed sourceIndex per emphasis entry in strictly increasing order.
Underline thickness and offset follow caption font size; inspect Arabic joins and neighbouring words.
This preserves the literal caption stream and cannot create a graphics-only transcript.

display.explains: يحط خط تحت كلمة مسجلة.
display.useWhen: مع شرط أو مصطلح محتاج تأكيد هادي.
display.avoidWhen: لو الخطوط هتزحم الكابشن.

items.explains: A directional mask introduces incoming graphics at a scene boundary.
items.action: Reveal through ClipReveal inside the split graphics panel or full takeover canvas without moving the source.
useWhen: A clean graphic entrance should preserve stable presenter framing and video decode.
avoidWhen: The requested action is a before/after comparison of the same subject.
The style-owned scene forbids shared transitions.
requirements: Put kind: clip-wipe in transitions exactly on the incoming scene first frame and finish within it.
Use one graphics entrance per scene; dir accepts rtl/ltr/up/down and manifest duration is 1-120 frames.
This is an entrance mask, not evidence-wipe, an object morph or an explanatory comparison.

display.explains: يكشف الجرافيك الجديد في اتجاه واضح.
display.avoidWhen: لو المطلوب مقارنة نفس الشيء قبل وبعد.

items.explains: A palette transition signals a chapter change between two supplied palettes.
items.action: Interpolate the previous and incoming chapter grounds and theme colours behind the new graphics.
useWhen: Adjacent scenes have deliberate validated chapter palettes.
avoidWhen: Either scene lacks chapter data.
A fixed identity requires a stable ground or an image crossfade is expected.
requirements: Start on the incoming scene first frame and supply chapter on it and the immediately previous scene.
Fit the duration inside the incoming scene, allow one hue crossfade per scene, and omit dir.
Presenter-only scenes are rejected; split background is bounded to the graphics seam.
This interpolates palettes rather than footage or evidence; preserve style and brand policy.

display.explains: ينقل لون الخلفية بين فصلين.
display.avoidWhen: لو مافيش chapter أو اللون لازم يثبت.

items.explains: A travelling light band accents arrival of a graphic state without proving any inspection.
items.action: Keep the graphics visible and sweep a bounded light band across them in the selected direction.
useWhen: A technical reveal needs a brief scan without moving its graphic layer.
A scene containing a capture needs an entrance without echo decoding.
avoidWhen: The scan would imply a real detection or analysis result.
It would cross presenter-only content or obscure source details.
requirements: Start on the scene first frame, finish within it, and use one graphics entrance.
dir accepts rtl/ltr/up/down; presenter-only scenes are rejected.
This is decorative illumination, not a semantic scanner, mask reveal or evidence of analysis.

display.explains: يمرر شريط نور على الجرافيك الجديد.
display.useWhen: لكشف تقني خفيف من غير تحريك الكارت.
display.avoidWhen: لو هيبان كأنه نتيجة فحص حقيقية.

items.explains: A brisk directional move announces a new graphic scene without moving the recording camera.
items.action: Translate incoming graphics with a short fade and speed-dependent smear inside the active panel.
useWhen: An energetic change benefits from direction and the incoming graphics tolerate echo rendering.
avoidWhen: The scene mounts video or a foreground recording.
A split panel requests up/down travel or the explanation needs a quiet entrance.
requirements: Start on the incoming scene first frame and finish within it; use one graphics entrance.
Split permits rtl/ltr only because up/down can smear into the presenter window.
The contract rejects video in supported screens, screen-focus, kinetic-hook foreground, Glide media or cartoon monitor video to avoid repeated decode per echo.
Apply it to graphics; it is no process, comparison or camera-track mechanism.

display.explains: يسحب الجرافيك الجديد بسرعة.
display.avoidWhen: مع فيديو جوه المشهد أو شرح هادي.

items.explains: Theme accent singles out one recorded token within kinetic text.
items.action: Apply accent colour to a supplied sourceIndex without changing token text, metrics or cue.
useWhen: A literal term needs colour distinction within a reviewed spoken phrase.
avoidWhen: Colour would imply unsupported classifications or results.
The text has no recorded counterpart.
requirements: Use the emphasis array of scene:kinetic-text and select one of its literal sourceIndices.
The canonical scene derives words from cut recording and rejects removed/out-of-scene selections.
Accent changes token ink only; it is not a data classification or source-free text mechanism.

display.explains: يلون كلمة مسجلة جوه الجرافيك.
display.avoidWhen: لو اللون هيوحي بنتيجة مش مدعومة.

items.explains: A Latin font face keeps a recorded Latin-containing token legible in mixed-language kinetic text.
items.action: Use the configured Latin face for the selected literal token while preserving its text and logical reading order.
useWhen: A reviewed Arabic phrase includes an actual Latin product name or technical term.
avoidWhen: The selected token has no Latin letter.
The intent is translation or inserting a term that was not recorded.
requirements: Use kind: latin only for a selected literal sourceIndex inside scene:kinetic-text.
resolveEmphasis rejects a Latin mark on a token with no Latin letter.
It selects a font rather than translating speech or authorising branded copy.
Review Arabic/Latin/digit runs without splitting Arabic characters.

display.explains: يدي المصطلح الإنجليزي المسجل خطه المناسب.
display.useWhen: مع اسم أداة أو مصطلح لاتيني مسجل.
display.avoidWhen: لو الكلمة مافيهاش حروف لاتينية.

items.explains: One literal token receives a stronger spring entrance than the line base.
items.action: Override that token entrance to pop with the pop spring preset; other words retain the scene entrance.
useWhen: One recorded keyword deserves an energetic accent.
avoidWhen: All words would receive equal marks and lose hierarchy.
The phrase needs low-motion reading or the word was not recorded.
requirements: Mark an existing selected sourceIndex in scene:kinetic-text; use actual cut words and timing.
Pop emphasis overrides both enter and spring preset, including on a fade/rise line.
The token scale begins at 0.55; inspect its bounds and Arabic integrity.
It differs from a caption pulse and cannot create a silent-project transcript.

display.explains: يدي كلمة مسجلة نبضة أقوى من باقي الجملة.
display.avoidWhen: لو كل الكلام هيبقى بنفس القوة.

items.explains: A drawn underline marks a particular reviewed token.
items.action: Draw a directional underline beneath its measured bounds after the recorded token entry.
useWhen: A recorded condition should stay stable while a mark points to it.
avoidWhen: The mark would collide with another line, captions or protected face.
The label is not one of the selected recorded words.
requirements: Use kind: underline on a selected sourceIndex in scene:kinetic-text; do not substitute free-form text.
The renderer derives mark geometry from token layout and times it after token entry.
Review actual mark reach, adjacent text, face and safe zones; schema success does not prove clarity.

display.explains: يرسم خط تحت كلمة من التسجيل.
display.useWhen: مع مصطلح أو شرط محتاج علامة.
display.avoidWhen: لو العلامة هتزحم الكلام أو الوش.

items.explains: Heavier font weight gives one literal token priority without an added animation.
items.action: Use configured heavy weight for the selected token while retaining family, text and entry timing.
useWhen: A serious or quiet recorded phrase needs restrained hierarchy.
avoidWhen: The distinction needs a real relationship or measurement.
The word is invented or the heavier glyphs cannot fit.
requirements: Select kind: weight for an existing literal sourceIndex in scene:kinetic-text.
tokenTypeStyle changes the measured token weight without an independent pulse.
Fit the actual heavier text and preserve reviewed words, timing and Arabic joins.

display.explains: يخلي كلمة التسجيل أتقل في الخط.
display.useWhen: لتأكيد هادي من غير حركة زيادة.
display.avoidWhen: لو المطلوب رسم علاقة أو الكلمة مش مسجلة.

items.explains: A presenter-to-split framing change creates graphic space while retaining the source subject.
items.action: Lower the graphics seam and interpolate the presenter window toward the lower split window while caption positions fade.
useWhen: A recorded presenter passage opens into a graphic explanation above the speaker.
Both supplied footage windows reach the bottom and split lies below full.
avoidWhen: The move is split-to-presenter or between takeover scenes.
There is no recording or the descending seam would crop the measured head.
requirements: Use layoutTransitions, not a family: kind curtain, from presenter, to split only.
Duration is 12-120 frames with an earlier from-layout frame; the interval and following frame must use to layout.
Order transitions without overlap and finish before signoff/edit end.
Explicit full/split windows must reach y=1920 with split.windowTop > full.windowTop; inspect head clearance throughout the descent.

display.explains: يفتح مساحة شرح فوق المتحدث.
display.useWhen: للانتقال من ظهور كامل إلى split.
display.avoidWhen: للرجوع من split أو من غير تسجيل.

items.explains: A continuous source-window change moves between presenter and split presentation.
items.action: Interpolate the recorded window and crop between the presenter and split geometries while fading caption positions.
useWhen: A recording alternates between personal delivery and graphic explanation.
The subject remains safely framed throughout the geometry path.
avoidWhen: A takeover graphic needs an explanatory object morph.
There is no earlier from-layout frame or an intermediate crop would hide the face.
requirements: Use kind window-morph in layoutTransitions with different from/to values drawn from presenter and split.
Duration is 12-120 frames; the prior frame is from and the interval plus following frame are to.
Transitions must be ordered, non-overlapping and finish before signoff/edit end.
It changes source window geometry, not an object identity; review source aspect, framing and measured head clearance.

display.explains: يغير مساحة المتحدث بين كامل وsplit.
display.avoidWhen: لو المقصود تحول عنصر جرافيك.

items.explains: A decaying white bloom marks a graphic arrival or cut.
items.action: Start a full-canvas white overlay at its peak on atFrame, then decay it over the supplied duration.
useWhen: A rare graphic reveal needs a crisp peak followed by immediate decay.
avoidWhen: The presenter is visible and speaking.
The scene needs a retained hold or its style forbids flashes.
requirements: Use transitions kind: bloom with no dir; duration maps to FlashBloom decaySec rather than a centred bell.
The default renderer peak is 0.8; the normal transition entry does not expose peak control.
Keep it off speaking footage and finish before signoff/edit end.
A bloom cannot explain a process or validate a result.

display.explains: يدي النقلة ومضة بيضا وتختفي.
display.useWhen: مع كشف جرافيك محتاج ضربة سريعة.
display.avoidWhen: فوق الكلام أو في ستايل يمنع الفلاش.

items.explains: A radial film-burn overlay gives a graphic cut a warm material accent.
items.action: Expand an amber-orange screen-blended radial glow while its opacity rises and falls.
useWhen: An approved analogue or warm editorial identity calls for a rare burn accent.
avoidWhen: A technical demonstration needs stable evidence colour.
The speaking presenter or caption reading would be washed out.
requirements: Use transitions kind: burn without dir; FilmBurn starts at atFrame for the supplied duration.
It is a whole-canvas screen-blended effect, not literal fire or a transformation of one object.
Keep it off the speaking presenter, preserve evidence colour, and finish before signoff/edit end.

display.explains: يضيف وهج حرق فيلم دافي للنقلة.
display.avoidWhen: لو الألوان أو الكلام محتاجين ثبات.

items.explains: A warm light streak gives a graphic cut a photographic accent.
items.action: Sweep a screen-blended warm streak across the canvas from the cue and fade it in a bell curve.
useWhen: A photographic or paper identity permits a restrained warm leak at a deliberate cut.
avoidWhen: Source skin or evidence colour must remain untouched.
Decorative light would interrupt a calm technical passage.
requirements: Use transitions kind: leak without dir; the normal renderer uses the streak LightLeak variant starting at atFrame.
Keep duration within 1-120 frames and finish before signoff and edit end.
The overlay covers the whole canvas with screen blending; keep it off the speaking presenter and important source detail.
It supplies atmosphere, not a semantic connection or verified change.

display.explains: يعدي تسريب ضوء دافي على النقلة.
display.useWhen: مع طابع تصويري أو ورقي يسمح بيه.
display.avoidWhen: لو هيغير الوش أو ألوان الدليل.

items.explains: A centred white flash accents a cut without conveying an explanation.
items.action: Raise a full-canvas white overlay in a bell curve centred on atFrame, then clear it.
useWhen: A rare deliberate graphic cut needs a strong flash allowed by its visual grammar.
avoidWhen: The presenter is speaking on screen.
A calm tutorial or readable proof needs uninterrupted legibility.
requirements: Use transitions kind: whiteout without dir; manifest duration is 1-120 frames.
The bell begins half its duration before atFrame; allow time on both sides and finish before signoff.
It overlays the whole canvas after captions and graphics; do not flash over a speaking presenter or important evidence.
A flash is dressing, not a claim, result or explanatory scene.

display.explains: يفلش الشاشة بالأبيض عند القطعة.
display.avoidWhen: فوق المتحدث أو دليل محتاج يتقري.

items.explains: Shared element arrival establishes a graphic composition, without explaining its relationship.
items.action: Shared Reveal elements rise about 28 pixels and scale from 0.985 to 1 with a card landing curve and short fade.
useWhen: A card should arrive decisively before its content is read.
The renderer actually consumes the shared motion variant.
avoidWhen: An input-to-output transformation or causal link must be shown.
A style-owned renderer uses its own entrance grammar.
requirements: Select motion: land on a compatible scene; this is an element entrance, not a scene family.
Shared Reveal starts at frame -2 without the per-order delay of stagger; exact use depends on the renderer.
Allow a readable settled hold; the entrance does not author the explanation.

display.explains: يدخل العناصر ويثبتها في مكانها.
display.avoidWhen: لو محتاج تحول يشرح علاقة بين حاجتين.

items.explains: Restrained shared arrival keeps attention on the content and delivery.
items.action: Use a 14-frame calm ramp with roughly 10 pixels of rise, a small 0.985-to-1 scale change and short opacity ramp.
useWhen: A calm teaching passage needs an unobtrusive card arrival.
avoidWhen: The requested state change still needs an explanatory scene.
The style-owned scene has its own explicit entrance contract.
requirements: Use motion: quiet on a compatible scene; quiet is restrained motion, not a static guarantee.
Shared Reveal still moves and scales elements; inspect the particular renderer before promising timing.
Keep a readable final hold and use an explanatory family for the actual meaning.

display.explains: يدخل الكارت بحركة بسيطة وهادية.
display.avoidWhen: لو الاسم الهادي هيخبي شرح ناقص.

items.explains: Ordered arrivals guide reading inside an existing composition.
items.action: Delay each shared Reveal by order times four frames, then use the card landing motion and fade.
useWhen: Existing cards have a meaningful reading order and sufficient hold time.
avoidWhen: A branch, queue or continuously moving payload must be shown.
The last delayed item would not have time to be read.
requirements: Use motion: stagger where the scene consumes it; shared start is -2 + order * 4.
It staggers arrivals only and does not make static process cards a stateful workflow.
Inspect the final delayed element and resolved hold at the actual fps.

display.explains: يدخل العناصر واحدة ورا التانية.
display.avoidWhen: لو آخر عنصر مش هيلحق يتقري.

items.explains: Supplies a Naskh claim-and-receipt grammar separating a statement from its supplied support.
items.action: Pair a strong Arabic claim with readable receipt sheets, brush rules and quiet composition; evidence comes from actual scene data or named assets.
useWhen: A case study needs to separate a claim from its sourced detail.
Considered Arabic reading and restrained evidence cards fit the delivery.
avoidWhen: The receipt appearance would make unsupported claims seem factual.
The demo needs dense moving controls or another fixed identity.
requirements: Noto Naskh Arabic is the declared default; profile brand colours are not automatic.
The style supplies no proof or data and owns no family.
Shared scene layout rules and evidence provenance still apply; inferred PiP needs review.

display.explains: هوية خط عربي تفصل الادعاء عن دليله.
display.avoidWhen: لو شكل الإيصال هيغطي ادعاء من غير سند.

items.explains: Supplies warm ticket-and-comment grammar for reviewed offers and audience interaction.
items.action: Combine perforated tickets, coral stubs, gold highlights and comment cards; scene data supplies the actual offer and conditions.
useWhen: A real offer or supplied audience question needs a clear invitation.
Warm campaign material fits the approved identity.
avoidWhen: The design would imply invented scarcity, comments or customer interest.
The layout needs presenter PiP inside a takeover.
requirements: It owns no family; ticket-offer/comment-stack have separate contracts and factual copy needs support.
Use its own warm gold palette and Cairo default; profile colours are not automatic.
PiP is not allowed; retain normal split where the scene permits it.
A visual ticket does not establish an entitlement, price, scarcity claim or testimonial.

display.explains: هوية تذاكر دافية وكروت أسئلة وتعليقات.
display.useWhen: لعرض حقيقي أو سؤال جمهور موثق.
display.avoidWhen: لو هتوحي بندرة أو تعليقات متخيلة.

items.explains: Supplies monochrome word-and-card grammar with fixed layouts and metronomic timing.
items.action: Use whole-word vertical slides, fixed bevel cards, one inverted box and owned push/cut/dip transitions; scene data supplies the actual content.
useWhen: A reviewed tutorial can use chapters, real captures and concise text.
The identity accepts full-frame owned scenes with presenter shots between them.
avoidWhen: The presenter must stay visible inside every owned scene.
The design needs coloured collage, springing words, floating cards or shared flashes/wipes.
requirements: Owned glide-chapter/card/lines/comment/follow families require style grid-glide and takeover layout.
Use the own monochrome palette, Grid Sans default and minimal captions; no automatic profile palette or PiP.
Owned word timing uses line anchors and metronome rather than canonical source-word entrances; use reviewed recorded or reviewed authored copy according to source mode.
Use owned push/cut/dip grammar and local hashed captures for glide-card; do not add shared transitions or word blur/scale.
Only author the actual applicable CTA and complete handle; a style does not invent the ending.

display.explains: هوية كلمات بتنزل لمكانها وكروت ثابتة.
display.useWhen: لشرح منظم بلقطات حقيقية ونص مختصر.
display.avoidWhen: لو المتحدث لازم يفضل ظاهر طول المشهد.

items.explains: Supplies a two-column verdict grammar with a clear divider and restrained hierarchy.
items.action: Organise supplied alternatives on serif-led verdict cards; the selected scene authors the supported comparison and conclusion.
useWhen: An opinion or comparison has explicit criteria and supplied alternatives.
Both sides should remain readable before the conclusion.
avoidWhen: Red/green styling would falsely settle an unsupported claim.
The explanation needs a continuously moving input rather than a held board.
requirements: The style owns no family and creates no factual verdict; author supported titles, details and evidence.
Use its own palette and Plex Display default; profile brand colours are not automatic.
Shared family layouts apply; inferred PiP still requires source/head review.

display.explains: هوية لوحة تخلي البدائل والحكم واضحين.
display.avoidWhen: لو الألوان هتحكم من غير دليل.

items.explains: Supplies poster-like ink-and-paper grammar for emphatic explanations.
items.action: Use heavy poster type, ink frames, signal strips and deliberate staggered reveals; a supported scene authors the actual explanation.
useWhen: A strong spoken idea benefits from bold typographic hierarchy.
A tutorial or comparison stays readable in an emphatic paper composition.
avoidWhen: The identity requires quiet receipts or understated photographic material.
Large type would replace evidence or cover the source face.
requirements: It owns no family; kinetic-text remains a separate literal-recorded-word mechanism.
The default font is Plex Display; the style uses its own palette rather than automatic profile colours.
PiP policy is inferred, so verify real geometry and creator fit rather than treating it as approval.

display.explains: هوية ورق وخط قوي وكشف مقصود.
display.avoidWhen: لو القوة هتغطي الدليل أو هدوء الفيديو.

items.explains: Supplies dark aurora and translucent-panel grammar for grouped details.
items.action: Use glass panels, product sans type and lens rims; token-lens or another family supplies actual grouping and focus.
useWhen: A technical explanation groups ideas or focuses on supplied details.
A dark luminous UI treatment fits the approved identity.
avoidWhen: Glow would reduce Arabic or source-detail contrast.
A takeover needs presenter PiP or the lens look would imply real optical analysis.
requirements: Grammar is not an inspection engine; lens scenes must point to supplied content.
Use the style own dark palette and Cairo default, not automatic profile colours.
PiP is not allowed; use split only where the selected family supports it.
Review actual glass-panel contrast and do not imply verified analysis from decorative magnification.

display.explains: هوية زجاج وعدسة لتفاصيل متجمعة.
display.useWhen: لشرح تقني فيه تركيز على تفصيلة.
display.avoidWhen: لو الوهج هيضعف قراءة الدليل.

items.explains: Supplies magazine-column grammar with chapters, quote rules and speaker attribution.
items.action: Use editorial headings and chapter rules with a legible speaker name/role; reviewed scene data supplies quotes.
useWhen: An interview or spoken opinion needs chapter structure and correctly attributed quotations.
Restrained editorial composition supports the speaker.
avoidWhen: The quote, speaker identity or role would be fabricated.
The takeover needs PiP or assumes an unsupplied cover foreground.
requirements: Grammar supplies no quote or identity; chapter-quote needs reviewed wording and supported attribution.
Use its own palette, Cairo default and minimal captions; profile colours are not automatic.
PiP is not allowed; use split with clear attribution where the selected family permits it.
Optional cover foreground requires the separate supplied transparent PNG contract; style selection does not mask a subject.

display.explains: هوية مجلة بفصول واقتباس وصاحبه واضح.
display.avoidWhen: لو الاقتباس أو هوية صاحبه مش موثقين.

items.explains: Supplies a continuous tutorial grammar of full-frame UI worlds and shaped bridges, not literal footage or product proof.
items.action: Use cream, ink and one accent, numbered steps and continuous world bridges; the owned one-shot scene supplies the validated chain and pull-back finale.
useWhen: A supported authored tutorial chain should feel visually uninterrupted.
The actual workflow fits current drop/field/toggle/stat/work contracts truthfully.
avoidWhen: Standalone four-second beats or a permanently visible presenter are required.
Synthetic UI worlds would imply verified captures or unimplemented product capabilities.
requirements: The owned one-shot family requires style one-shot and takeover; PiP is not allowed, so use presenter shots between scenes.
Use its own palette, Noto Kufi Arabic default and minimal captions; profile colours are not automatic.
Follow the step-chain schema and chainIssues with duration >= oneShotMinFrames(data,fps), rather than arbitrary short beats.
UI worlds and result words are authored illustrations; use reviewed copy and supported numbers without claiming live captures or measured results.
Returning to the home view is a playback loop, not a semantic feedback mechanism.

display.explains: هوية شرح متصل كل خطوة تفتح اللي بعدها.
display.avoidWhen: لو محتاج ٤ ثواني أو متحدث ظاهر طول الوقت.

items.explains: Supplies an illustrated-narrator explainer grammar: alternating paper and night acts, a word-built headline, a top band with an honest counter and generic cards, with the creator never on screen.
items.action: Use the act palettes, the Plex display face with a serif italic for Latin words and minimal captions; the owned cartoon and cartoon-ending scenes carry the whole edit.
useWhen: A recorded explainer or tutorial should be told by an illustrated narrator instead of the creator’s face.
The ideas fit the generic card vocabulary and the recording states every number it shows.
avoidWhen: The presenter must stay visible, or the passage needs real footage beyond a monitor card.
There is no recording to drive the words, the mouth and the timing.
requirements: The owned families require style cartoon, takeover and sourceKind "cartoon"; PiP is not allowed and brand colours are not applied.
The character comes from preferences.character or the generic default; it is never a photo.
Follow the word-anchor contracts in instructions/styles/cartoon.md; the timeline validator names any sentence, act or card to fix.

display.explains: هوية شرح بشخصية مرسومة وخلفيات بتتقلب.
display.useWhen: لشرح من غير ما تظهر بصوتك المسجل.
display.avoidWhen: لو لازم تظهر أو مفيش تسجيل.

items.explains: Supplies layered taped-paper grammar whose meaningful pieces form a coherent whole.
items.action: Use taped cards, tabs, readable overlap and restrained depth; a suitable scene preserves object identity through assembly or comparison.
useWhen: A story or comparison has pieces with distinct explanatory roles.
The video already has a fixed paper-collage identity.
avoidWhen: Extra scraps add no relationship or hide labels.
Paper texture would alter the presenter or a profile palette is being forced onto the style.
requirements: This is grammar, not an assembly mechanism; message-board or a suitable authored scene supplies actual continuity.
brand:false and the Tajawal default preserve the style own palette/material rather than automatic profile colours.
Split/takeover support depends on the chosen family; inferred PiP needs real face/layout review.
Keep paper texture on graphics and tie sparse paper sounds to visible action.

display.explains: هوية قصاصات بتوضح صلة الأجزاء.
display.avoidWhen: لو القصاصات هتزود زحمة من غير معنى.

items.explains: Supplies paper-route grammar with station markers and optional taped photos.
items.action: Arrange route-paper cards and numbered markers as a journey; route-stops supplies ordered cues and optional images.
useWhen: A tutorial or story follows supplied ordered milestones.
Optional photos have clear roles and provenance.
avoidWhen: A decorative route would be presented as a real geographic map.
The plan needs branching, feedback or a moving payload absent from the selected family.
requirements: The style is grammar, not map geometry or a conditional workflow; use an actual scene contract.
Its paper palette and Tajawal default do not automatically inherit profile colours.
PiP is not allowed; shared scene layout limits still apply.
Named sources are required for optional photos; geography needs verified geometry and labels.

display.explains: هوية رحلة على ورق بمحطات واضحة.
display.useWhen: لخطوات أو محطات مرتبة وليها مصدر.
display.avoidWhen: لو الزخرفة هتتقدم كخريطة حقيقية.

items.explains: Supplies a dark section grammar with strong headings and held clause captions.
items.action: Compose kicker, accent answer, semantic chips and ordered held sections; a process/comparison scene supplies the relationship.
useWhen: The explanation divides naturally into stages, chapters or comparison criteria.
Calm reading and supported palette cycling serve the material.
avoidWhen: Each sentence would become an unrelated slide.
The layout needs presenter PiP inside a takeover.
requirements: The style owns no scene family; use shared split/takeover contracts.
Brand colours follow the supported three-ground deck policy rather than one colour per sentence.
Clause captions and static pills are defaults; caption pop and presenter PiP are not allowed.

display.explains: هوية فصول بعناوين وإجابات واضحة.
display.useWhen: لشرح متقسم مراحل أو معايير مقارنة.
display.avoidWhen: لو هنحول كل جملة لسلايد منفصلة.

items.explains: Supplies warm product-UI grammar for simultaneous presenter delivery and visual explanation.
items.action: Use a product canvas above a continuous presenter window, rounded cards, accent rules and stable caption pills; the selected scene supplies the explanatory action.
useWhen: A presenter and one demonstrated graphic idea should remain visible together.
Supported profile brand colours belong to the approved identity.
avoidWhen: The upper graphic only repeats captions.
Evidence would be unreadable above the presenter or a different style is fixed.
requirements: Grammar alone does not supply a process or screen scene; inspect each selected family layout.
Brand support uses one ground with primary/accent highlights alternating under the supported profile policy.
Caption pills are static and reject caption-emphasis:pop; declared PiP still needs real source/head review.

display.explains: هوية UI دافية والشرح فوق المتحدث.
display.useWhen: لشرح فيه متحدث وديمو واضح معاه.
display.avoidWhen: لو الديمو هيصغر ومش هيتقري.

items.explains: Supplies an editorial-spread grammar with offset plates and marked supporting detail.
items.action: Use serif-led headings, offset plates and yellow-marker annotations while the scene carries the actual argument.
useWhen: An opinion or case study moves from a claim to marked support.
Editorial hierarchy connects successive thoughts without replacing their source.
avoidWhen: Offsets or marker strokes make evidence harder to read.
A fixed UI or collage identity would change merely for variety.
requirements: This style supplies composition and annotations, not argument truth or object continuity.
Its own palette and Plex Display default do not automatically inherit profile colours.
Shared layouts and head clearance remain required; PiP support is inferred.

display.explains: هوية تحريرية تبرز الكلام والدليل بعلامات.
display.useWhen: لرأي أو دراسة حالة ليها سند واضح.
display.avoidWhen: لو العلامات هتصعب القراءة.

items.explains: A short opacity fade introduces recorded tokens without translation or scaling.
items.action: Fade each literal word to opaque over four frames at its recorded entry cue.
useWhen: A quiet phrase needs kinetic emphasis with stable token positions.
avoidWhen: The words or timing are not reviewed against the recording.
A silent authored scene needs free text instead of source-word selection.
requirements: Use enter: fade in scene:kinetic-text with actual reviewed sourceIndices, language and scene headings.
Selected words remain inside the scene and outside cut boundaries; captions remain a separate existing stream.
The normal fade has no rise/scale, but individual pop emphasis overrides it.
Source-free graphics cannot supply a fabricated transcript for this effect.

display.explains: يظهر كلمات التسجيل بهدوء من غير طلوع.
display.avoidWhen: لو مافيش كلمات تسجيل مراجعة.

items.explains: A spring scale entrance gives literal spoken words an energetic arrival.
items.action: Start each selected token at scale 0.55 and spring to full size with a two-frame opacity entrance.
useWhen: An energetic recorded phrase supports strong word arrivals with space around tokens.
avoidWhen: Calm sustained reading is the priority.
The words are invented, reordered or absent from the recording.
requirements: Use scene:kinetic-text enter: pop with 1-32 valid literal sourceIndices and reviewed timing.
Scale whole measured tokens, not Arabic characters; keep source wording and order.
Check spring bounds and distinguish this from caption-emphasis:pop.
It cannot create literal words for a source-free graphics project.

display.explains: يدخل كلمات التسجيل بنبضة واضحة.
display.avoidWhen: لشرح هادي أو كلام مش مسجل.

items.explains: A short rise introduces selected literal recorded words in kinetic text.
items.action: Bring each token upward from 0.42 of its measured height with a short opacity ramp on the recorded entry frame.
useWhen: A reviewed spoken phrase benefits from readable restrained word-led emphasis.
avoidWhen: The copy is unrecorded authored text for silent graphics.
Another word layer would replace the needed diagram.
requirements: Set enter: rise in scene:kinetic-text with 1-32 strictly ordered literal sourceIndices and lang ar/en.
Words must survive cuts and lie inside the scene; preserve reviewed content and timing.
The rise uses six frames and opacity uses three; individual pop emphasis overrides the base entrance.
This is not unrestricted TypeOn and cannot manufacture a graphics transcript.

display.explains: يطلع كلمات التسجيل لفوق وقت نطقها.
display.avoidWhen: لكلام مؤلف من غير تسجيل.
